name: copilotprompts-prompt-github-canvas-to-code-app-plan-prompt
title: Plan a canvas app to code app migration with GitHub Copilot
shortDescription: Paste a canvas app's screens, data sources and Power Fx, and GitHub Copilot returns a migration plan to a Power Apps code app, from the fit decision through the data layer and effort to a rebuild, keep or split recommendation.
longDescription: A GitHub Copilot prompt for solution architects weighing whether an existing canvas app should become a Power Apps code app. The prompt carries the platform facts as of October 2026 that decide the answer, including the Power Apps CLI and the @microsoft/power-apps client library, per-user Premium licensing, the canvas features with no code app equivalent, the limits of native Dataverse access and the flows a code app can call. Copilot asks up to three questions, then writes a plan in seven fixed sections ending in a rebuild, keep or split recommendation.
